fields.status: Bring-up; the maintainer reports that the six Bob and Jet/Access Basic modules lift to link-clean C, Bob's real startup and MFC window creation execute, and Jet opens the original databases. fields.summary: Static recompilation of the original Win16 Bob house application, its engine, blitter, and load-bearing Jet/Access Basic modules into C. The host/runtime reconstructs Win16, Jet, and WinG behavior; the project has reached real application initialization and database opens but has not yet drawn the Bob house. Original binaries, data, and lifted C are user-generated and are not distributed.
